item.stem:
The diagram shows cross-sections of two transparent curved glass pieces, L and M. Rhea compares thickness at the middle with thickness near the edges of each piece.

Which classification is correct?

options.A: L is a convex lens and M is a concave lens.
options.B: L is a concave lens and M is a convex lens.
options.C: Both are concave lenses because both outlines look curved.
options.D: M is a convex lens because it is made of transparent glass.
